programme.title: Alancheri Thamprakkal
programme.desc: Meera arrives at brothers Chathukutty Bhagavathar and Chandappan Gurukkal's house claiming to be the Bhagavathar's daughter. However, another man reaches the village and insists that he is her father.

programme.title: Gayathridevi Ente Amma
programme.desc: Appu's father lies to him that his mother is dead. Devoid of a mother's love, Appu resorts to smoking and drinking until he learns that she is still alive.

programme.title: Chamayam
programme.desc: Rival fishermen Esthappan and Anto set aside differences when their shared passion for theatre opens doors to experiences beyond their everyday lives.

programme.title: Pulliman
programme.desc: Kunjunni, an orphan, and Radha, who makes a living by selling statues of deities, love each other. However, problems arise when her father opposes their relationship.

programme.title: Appu
programme.desc: Appukuttan falls in love with Sarojini, who does not reciprocate his feelings. Things take a dramatic turn when Sarojini is found murdered and Appukuttan is implicated in the crime.

programme.title: 7th Day
programme.desc: When two friends run into David, an IPS official, they reveal an unfortunate event that changed their lives. David helps them get out of the mess, but he is not what he claims to be.

programme.title: Vellathooval
programme.desc: Jiya, a fun-loving girl, is tired of her conservative family and therefore decides to abscond with her friend Manu. They become good friends, but society misunderstands them.

programme.title: Unnikrishnante Adyathe Christmas
programme.desc: Sophia has an argument with her parents over her marriage and leaves the house. Her parents seek the help of her close friend, Unnikrishnan, in getting her back in the house.

programme.title: Indrajith
programme.desc: Bhasi follows in his father, Bhaskaran's footsteps and becomes a local goon. He has to deal with Achan Kunju, who plans to get back at Bhaskaran for humiliating his father years ago.

programme.title: Vinayapoorvam Vidyadharan
programme.desc: Vidyadharan is a simple bank employee, but his meagre earnings are insufficient for his wife's extravagant lifestyle. Eventually, she costs him his job, forcing him to struggle.

programme.title: Parvathy Parinayam
programme.desc: Parvathy, a young woman, falls in love with Sivankutty, a lineman, but her mother disapproves of her relationship. Shortly after, her father returns after 18 years and fixes her marriage to an engineer.

programme.title: Uppukandam Brothers
programme.desc: Ananthan Pilla murders Chacko for being an informer of his illicit business. When the police refuse to file a complaint, Chacko's son approaches a prominent family known as the Uppukandam Brothers.

programme.title: Pilots
programme.desc: A pilot, who is falsely accused of murder, finds his deceased friend's sister masquerading as a nun. To clear his name, he must convince her to reveal the truth and testify on his behalf.

programme.title: Agnidevan
programme.desc: Two brothers are constantly at odds over continuing their family legacy. Eventually, their rivalry reaches extreme proportions, threatening to destroy the bond of brotherhood.

programme.title: Mookkilla Rajyathu Murimookkan Rajavu
programme.desc: Three unemployed bachelors go in search of a house. A man allows them to stay with him until they get a place, but things turn topsy-turvy when they get involved in the family issues of this man.

programme.title: Govindankutty Thirakkilanu
programme.desc: Govindankutty faces several obstacles after he inherits an ancestral property which often results in hilarious situations.

programme.title: Kadamba
programme.desc: Complications arise when Kadamba, a policeman and his wife Yamini realise that they are being followed by a shooter who is causing troubles in their lives.

programme.title: Swathi Thirunal
programme.desc: Gowri Lakshmi Bayi entrusts the four-month-old Swathi Thirunal Rama Varma to the care of the English East India Company.

programme.title: Janmandharam
programme.desc: Four bachelors bravely fight against the injustice meted out towards the villagers. However, they land in trouble when they go up against the evil landlord, Panikkar.

programme.title: Again Kasargod Khader Bhai
programme.desc: Kasim Bhai is found murdered. The suspicion falls on the Kaladarshana team and the unfolding of the murder mystery forms the rest of the story.

programme.title: Kadha
programme.desc: After a long wait, Madhava and Sethulekshmi are blessed with a male child, Nandu. They want him to become a doctor, but problems arise when he has other plans after growing up.

programme.title: Moonnam Mura
programme.desc: Charles and his group of men hijack a bus filled with politicians and demand the release of their colleagues from prison. An ex-police officer, Ali Imran, is summoned to solve the problem.

programme.title: Akkare Ninnoru Maran
programme.desc: Achuthan loves a girl, but her father wants only a man working abroad to marry her. To trick her father, he pretends to go to Dubai for a job but stays in a nearby hotel.

programme.title: Magic Magic
programme.desc: Little Indrajeet migrates to New York as per his father's wish of educating him abroad. However, he is unable to adapt to the new lifestyle and tries to run away.

programme.title: Oozham
programme.desc: After he witnesses his entire family getting murdered over a video call, Surya decides to avenge their deaths. His fiancée, Gayathri, who is mourning the death of her brother, is ready to help him.

programme.title: Chakkikotha Chankaran
programme.desc: Pradeep marries Roshni without his family's consent. However, Roshni decides to move to her friend Shailaja's house with Pradeep, unaware that she is Pradeep's sister-in-law.

programme.title: Chanchattam
programme.desc: Mohan and Yamuna fall in love with each other and get married. However, their marriage hits troubled waters after Mohan confesses that he unexpectedly cheated on her with one of her friends.

programme.title: Detective
programme.desc: Reshmi, the wife of a young political leader, Mohan Kumar, commits suicide just when he is gearing up for a by-election. An inquiry team led by Shyam Prasad is tasked to find out the reason behind it.

programme.title: Thanmathra
programme.desc: A family has to deal with the fact that the father, who is also the one that holds the family together, has developed Alzheimer's disease.

programme.title: Adikkurippu
programme.desc: Basheer, a castaway with no memory, is found in the sea by a ship's captain. Later, when Basheer faces several murder attempts, Advocate Bhaskara Pillai unravels a sinister world of crime.

programme.title: Beautiful
programme.desc: Stephen, a quadriplegic, befriends John, a musician, and they develop a good rapport. However, their friendship is put to the test when Anjali enters their lives.

programme.title: Focus IV
programme.desc: Bringing the best in television.

programme.title: Oridathu
